props.label: Reading guide
props.title: AI changes the voice, not the operating facts

props.content: The deterministic column is what Suntiq can always produce. The AI column adds a compressed operator narrative over the same figures. Morning and weekly already contain enough structure to stand on their own; this preview makes the incremental value—and cost—visible.

props.title: Not a provider test
props.content: The AI prose was authored locally from the exact checked-in prompts. Every number passed the repository's honesty checker, but no OpenRouter request or push delivery occurred.
